meta.name: feedback
meta.description: Assess a field lesson for reuse or product feedback without exposing customer context. Use for recurring deployment lessons; distinguish a hypothesis from a validated pattern.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把现场教训整理成可复用的做法或产品反馈,同时隐去客户信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队反复踩同类部署坑,却难把现场经验沉淀成可复用做法。
copy.tagline_en: Turn field lessons into reusable patterns or product feedback.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team keeps hitting the same field issues and struggles to capture lessons.

howto.what: 帮你评估一条现场经验是否值得复用或作为产品反馈,过程中不暴露客户上下文,并区分它只是假设还是已验证的模式。
howto.when: 当出现反复发生的部署经验需要评估时使用;若由 @fde 调用,会复用其当前已脱敏的包和范围,不重启设置或已答过的问题。

say.text: 评估这条部署经验能否复用,别暴露客户信息
say.note: 先读任务上下文契约与方法

say.text: 这条经验算假设还是已验证的模式?
@fde 调用,用现有脱敏包继续评估

howto.what_en: Assesses a field lesson for reuse or product feedback without exposing customer context, and separates a hypothesis from a validated pattern.
howto.when_en: Use it for recurring deployment lessons; when @fde calls it, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.
